parent_evidence.authorized_information_unit: BTC displacement followed by SOL/XRP beta-residual overextension; opportunity-only result, no inherited PnL.

dates.calendar_rule: Sunday one week after each previously used monthly anchor, fixed before outcome access.

market.venue: Bybit USDT linear perpetual public trade archive

signal.beta: prior-only 30-minute rolling BTC-to-follower beta with minimum observation and nonzero-return gates
signal.event_rearm: BTC displacement must decay to 25 percent of its initial shock for ten completed 100 ms states.

payoff.mss_confirmation: Initial residual contracts to at most 90 percent while one-second follower aggressive flow flips opposite the original displacement for three completed 100 ms states.
payoff.target: Residual overextension contracts to at most 25 percent for ten completed 100 ms states.
payoff.stop: Residual expands to at least 150 percent or follower extends another 50 percent of the initial residual gap against the reversal.
payoff.leader_invalidation: BTC displacement crosses its origin for ten completed 100 ms states.
payoff.source_boundary: Unresolved positions receive the full modeled stop and retain the slot through the source boundary.
payoff.funding_boundary: Any crossed funding boundary receives full-stop treatment and fails the zero-unavailable gate.

routing.top_trade_removal: Remove the largest ten percent of positive 12 bp event keys, then reroute the entire global-slot path.
